answer: WITH f AS (SELECT d."RecordRegistry" AS flow_id, (r.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'risk_score')::numeric * (1 / NULLIF((r.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'control_effectiveness_pct')::numeric, 0)) AS res, ((d.flow_overview->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric / ((d.flow_overview->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1)) * (1 - (d.flow_overview->'performance'->>'retry_count')::numeric / ((d.flow_overview->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1)) AS dfrs FROM "DataFlow" d JOIN "RiskManagement" r ON r.flow_link = d."RecordRegistry") SELECT flow_id, ROUND(res, 2) AS res, ROUND(dfrs, 2) AS dfrs FROM f WHERE res > 0.7 AND dfrs < 0.5

WITH a AS (SELECT d."RecordRegistry" AS flow_id, a."critFindNum"::numeric / (a."FINDTALLY" + 1) AS afs, (COALESCE(a."AccReqNum",0) + COALESCE(a."DEL_REQ_NUM",0) + COALESCE(a.rect_req_num,0) + COALESCE(a."PORTREQNUM",0))::numeric AS dsrl, DATE '2025-04-01' - a."REMED_DUE" AS days_overdue FROM "AuditAndCompliance" a JOIN "DataProfile" p ON p."profileTrace" = a.profjoin JOIN "DataFlow" d ON d."RecordRegistry" = p."Flow_Sign" WHERE d.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' <> d.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country'), s AS (SELECT flow_id, (afs * dsrl) * afs AS acp, days_overdue FROM a) SELECT flow_id, ROUND(acp, 2) AS audit_compliance_pressure, days_overdue FROM s WHERE acp > 5 AND days_overdue > 0 AND days_overdue <= 5 ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, acp DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT "profileTrace" AS profile_id, (CASE WHEN "Int_check" = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN "CSUMVERIFY" = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ifc, CONCAT_WS(', ', CASE WHEN "Int_check" = 'Failed' THEN 'Integrity Check' END, CASE WHEN "CSUMVERIFY" = 'Failed' THEN 'Checksum Verification' END) AS failure_types FROM "DataProfile" WHERE "Int_check" = 'Failed' OR "CSUMVERIFY" = 'Failed' ORDER BY ifc DESC, profile_id LIMIT 10

WITH f AS (SELECT d."RecordRegistry" AS flow_id, (r.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'risk_score')::numeric * (1 / NULLIF((r.risk_management_profile->'assessment'->>'control_effectiveness_pct')::numeric, 0)) AS res, p.vol_gb::numeric * CASE p."dataSense" WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS dsi FROM "DataFlow" d LEFT JOIN "RiskManagement" r ON r.flow_link = d."RecordRegistry" LEFT JOIN "DataProfile" p ON p."Flow_Sign" = d."RecordRegistry") SELECT flow_id, ROUND(res, 2) AS risk_exposure_score, ROUND(dsi, 2) AS data_sensitivity_index FROM f WHERE res > 0.7 AND dsi > 100 ORDER BY dsi DESC LIMIT 5

WITH a AS (SELECT "AUDIT_TRACE" AS audit_id, (COALESCE("AccReqNum",0) + COALESCE("DEL_REQ_NUM",0) + COALESCE(rect_req_num,0) + COALESCE("PORTREQNUM",0))::numeric * resp_time_day::numeric AS dsrp, 'Access: ' || COALESCE("AccReqNum",0) || ', Deletion: ' || COALESCE("DEL_REQ_NUM",0) || ', Rectification: ' || COALESCE(rect_req_num,0) || ', Portability: ' || COALESCE("PORTREQNUM",0) AS request_breakdown FROM "AuditAndCompliance") SELECT audit_id, ROUND(dsrp, 2) AS dsrp, request_breakdown FROM a WHERE dsrp > 50 ORDER BY dsrp DESC LIMIT 100
note: Request breakdown rendered as one text column.

answer: WITH a AS (SELECT TO_CHAR("REMED_DUE", 'YYYY-MM') AS month, "critFindNum"::numeric / ("FINDTALLY" + 1) AS afs FROM "AuditAndCompliance" WHERE "REMED_DUE" IS NOT NULL), m AS (SELECT month, AVG(afs) AS avg_afs FROM a WHERE afs > 0.5 GROUP BY month), r AS (SELECT month, avg_afs, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_afs DESC) AS severity_rank FROM m) SELECT month, ROUND(avg_afs, 2) AS avg_afs, severity_rank FROM r WHERE severity_rank <= 3 ORDER BY month
note: Audit table has no audit date; month taken from REMED_DUE (remediation due date).

answer: WITH v AS (SELECT CASE "vendSecRate" WHEN 'A' THEN 4 WHEN 'B' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'D' THEN 1 END * CASE WHEN "contrState" = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0.5 END AS vri FROM "VendorManagement"), t AS (SELECT CASE WHEN vri < 2 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN vri < 3 THEN 'Medium Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END AS tier FROM v) SELECT tier, COUNT(*) AS vendor_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage FROM t GROUP BY tier ORDER BY vendor_count DESC

WITH f AS (SELECT "RecordRegistry" AS flow_id, (flow_overview->'performance'->>'bandwidth_util_pct')::numeric * ((flow_overview->'performance'->>'data_size_mb')::numeric / NULLIF((flow_overview->'performance'->>'duration_min')::numeric, 0)) AS bsi, (flow_overview->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric / ((flow_overview->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1) AS dte FROM "DataFlow") SELECT flow_id, ROUND(bsi, 2) AS bsi, ROUND(dte, 2) AS dte FROM f WHERE bsi > 50 AND dte < 1.0 ORDER BY bsi DESC LIMIT 10

WITH p AS (SELECT dp."profileTrace" AS profile_id, dp.vol_gb::numeric * CASE dp."dataSense" WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS dsi, CASE WHEN s.enc_state = 'Full' AND s.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 3 WHEN s.enc_state = 'Full' OR s.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS srs FROM "DataProfile" dp JOIN "SecurityProfile" s ON s.profile_key = dp."profileTrace") SELECT profile_id, ROUND(dsi, 2) AS dsi, srs FROM p WHERE dsi > 100 AND srs < 2 ORDER BY dsi DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT c."complianceTrace" AS record_id, c."gdprComp" AS gdpr_status, c.loc_law_comp AS local_law_status, (d.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country') || ' -> ' || (d.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country') AS transfer_route FROM "Compliance" c JOIN "DataFlow" d ON d."RecordRegistry" = c."recordRegistry" WHERE ((d.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country') IS DISTINCT FROM (d.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country') OR d.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' IS NULL OR d.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' IS NULL) AND (c."gdprComp" = 'Non-compliant' OR c.loc_law_comp = 'Non-compliant') ORDER BY c."complianceTrace" LIMIT 10
